name: 3D-printed airbrush adapter for a pancake air compressor

mentions.name: 3D-printed airbrush adapter for a pancake air compressor
mentions.description: A 3D-printed adapter, modeled in Blender with custom threads, that lets an airbrush be used with a standard pancake air compressor.
mentions.problem: An airbrush needed an adapter to work with a standard pancake air compressor.
mentions.source_excerpt: A few weeks ago I was working on an adapter for an airbrush to use on a standard pancake air compressor. Learning to create threads in blender was really neat!
